metaDescription: Repovio brings workflow runs, issues, pull requests and security alerts into a self-hosted, read-only dashboard.
heroDescription: Workflow runs, issues, pull requests and security alerts. One place to see what needs your attention across GitHub, GitLab, Forgejo and Gitea.
heroNote: Your providers stay in control. Repovio brings the overview.
previewDescription: Current failures, approval queues and repository health, scoped to the repositories you can access.
screenshotAlt: Repovio dashboard showing synthetic workflow activity and repository health.
screenshotNote: Actual Repovio interface with synthetic demonstration data.
installDescription: Deploy the API, web application and PostgreSQL with Docker Compose. Configure your secrets, then create the first administrator in your browser.
installNote: Application source and images currently require repository and package access. Follow the installation guide for the matching release.
readOnlyText: Repovio reads provider resources. Fix failures, review changes and approve workflows in their original provider.
featureWorkflowsText: Find current failures, pending approvals, execution history and success trends across your tracked repositories.
featureWorkText: Review open work and stale issues alongside the workflow runs that belong to them.
featureSecurityText: Review dependency, code scanning and secret scanning metadata where the provider and your permissions support it.
featureNotificationsText: Route workflow events to email, Gotify, ntfy, Discord, browser push or custom Apprise destinations.
featurePermissionsText: Local accounts or OpenID Connect, repository memberships and role-aware queries keep each view permission-scoped.
featureMcpText: Connect compatible clients through personal access tokens and query the same repositories your user may access.
legalDraftText: This website is a development preview. Operator contact details, hosting provider and log-retention information must be confirmed before public deployment.
privacyText: This implementation stores language and color preferences in your browser. Documentation search uses the site content. No analytics or advertising integration is included. Hosting and connection-data processing depend on the final deployment; its operator must complete this notice before launch.

product_mcpFlowNote: MCP reads the local database. It does not start synchronization or change provider resources.
product_integrationsDescription: Connect your providers, notification destinations, and compatible MCP clients.
product_requirements: Docker Compose, PostgreSQL, a TLS reverse proxy, and access to the private application images. Follow the deployment files for your release.
product_github: Workflow runs, issues, pull requests, and security alert metadata, subject to API permissions and repository configuration.
product_gitlab: Pipelines, issues, and merge requests. Security findings depend on instance capabilities, licensing, and token permissions.
product_forgejo: Workflow and work-item data depend on instance capabilities. Dependency, code, and secret alert types are currently unsupported.
product_details_dashboard_useCase: Review failures, approval queues, and success trends together before starting your day. Filter by repository and time range to focus on the work you can access.
product_details_dashboard_limit: Results reflect synchronized data and your current permissions. An empty dashboard does not prove every repository is healthy.
product_details_workflow-monitoring_useC: Find the latest failed workflow context, inspect run history, and identify runs waiting for approval. Open the provider to investigate logs and take action.
product_details_workflow-monitoring_limi: Repovio cannot start, rerun, cancel, or approve workflows. Available run data depends on the provider and token permissions.
product_details_issues-pull-requests_use: Review open issues and pull requests across tracked repositories. Use filters and associated workflow status to identify stale work and failing checks.
product_details_issues-pull-requests_lim: Edit issues, review changes, and merge at the provider. Available fields differ by provider.
product_details_security-alerts_useCase: Triage dependency, code, and secret scanning metadata by severity and repository. Open a finding at its provider to investigate and remediate.
product_details_security-alerts_limit: Alert access requires repository management permissions. GitLab support depends on instance and license; Forgejo and Gitea do not support these alert types. Secret values are never retained.
product_details_notifications_useCase: Subscribe channels to workflow and security events. Route notifications to email, Gotify, ntfy, Discord, browser push, or an Apprise destination, and inspect delivery history.
product_details_notifications_limit: System administrators manage channels. Browser push requires device consent and server configuration; delivery depends on the destination.
product_details_access-control_useCase: Use local accounts or OpenID Connect for sign-in. Assign roles and repository memberships so each user sees the data their work requires.
product_details_access-control_limit: Provider OAuth connects repository data; it is separate from user sign-in. Alert access requires management permissions, and system administrators have broader access.
product_details_mcp_useCase: Ask a compatible client for visible repositories, failed workflows, approval queues, summaries, or trends through a personal MCP token.
product_details_mcp_limit: Clients must support custom HTTP authorization headers. MCP OAuth discovery, provider actions, configuration changes, and synchronization triggers are not available.
